 Deals and Sales Apple AirPods Pro 3 are 28% off right now — get them before they sell out
 The popular earbuds are at their low Prime Day price. Nov. 21, 2026, 7:00 AM EST Bethany Heitman
 Commerce Editor
 The earbuds come with a range of tip sizes to help you get the perfect fit. Amazon Apple products rarely get big discounts, but right now the AirPods Pro 3 are 28% off their usual price. This deal means they match their low Prime Day price and, with Black Friday shopping picking up,there is a good chance these may sell out quickly. If you are on the hunt for a new pair of earbud or looking for an easy tech gift, they are worth your consideration. Here’s what to know before you buy.
 Apple AirPods Pro 3 
 $ 179.00 $ 249.00 Amazon Now 28% off $ 179.99 $ 249.99 Target Now 28% off $ 179.99 $ 249.99 Best Buy Now 28% off The Apple AirPods Pro 3 have active noise cancellation that is twice as strong as the previous version. They also have foam-infused ear tips that help them seal better and improve the sound and come with a range of tip sizes to help you get a perfect fit. You get about eight hours of listening time on a full charge with noise cancellation and both the earbuds and the charging case are rated IP57 , so they hold up against dust, sweat and water.
 These earbuds also do more than play music. A built-in heart rate sensor tracks your pulse during workouts and shows the data in the Fitness app on your iPhone, which means you don’t need a watch to track it. The live translation feature helps you follow conversations in other languages and a hearing aid feature amplifies nearby voices for people with mild to moderate hearing loss. The case charges over USB-C or a Qi wireless charger, and the earbuds switch automatically between your other Apple items.
 Why this sale is worth it
 28% off
 Matches Prime Day pricing 
 Active noise cancellation
